properties.name: governance.core.actor-header
properties.description: Plain HTTP header carrying the caller's identity, e.g. a gateway- or auth-proxy-injected user id / service account name. Deliberately just a header - no Spring Security dependency - so every governance module built on core has zero requirement on any particular auth mechanism.

properties.name: governance.core.actor-mdc-key
properties.description: MDC key the resolved actor is read from by downstream modules.

properties.name: governance.core.correlation-id-header
properties.description: Header used to propagate a request's correlation id end-to-end.

properties.name: governance.core.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the shared correlation-id/actor filter.

properties.name: governance.core.mask-sensitive-data
properties.description: Whether @Sensitive fields/values are masked before logging/publishing, fleet-wide default.

properties.name: governance.core.mdc-key
properties.description: MDC key the correlation id is stored under for log pattern usage.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the governance endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the governance endpoint.
